dct_creator_sm: Centre for Biodiversity Genomics, University of Guelph.
dct_description_sm: Under the auspices of the Arctic BIOSCAN project supported by Polar Knowledge Canada, a pilot study was conducted to assess the utility of DNA metabarcoding approaches to assess the biological diversity of Arctic soil samples. The field work was conducted in the vicinity of Cambridge Bay in the summer of 2018. Molecular analysis was done at the Centre for Biodiversity Genomics, University of Guelph.
dct_title_s: DNA Metabarcoding Analysis of Soil Communities in the Cambridge Bay Area
